messages:
Alex Morgan: Hey team, just finished turning on my company MBP and it's stuck on "Waiting for device enrollment" during setup. I've left it on the office wifi for 20 mins. macOS 13.6.1. Anyone seen this?
IT Support: Thanks Alex — can you confirm model and serial? Also are you on the corp proxy network?
Alex Morgan: MacBook Pro (14-inch, M2) serial: C02X1234LQD4
Alex Morgan: Yep connected to REDWOOD-GUEST while I waited, then switched to REDWOOD-EMP. No captive portal prompts.
Devex Karen: @IT Support FYI new hire. Alex — if it's switching networks during enroll it can break the MDM handshake. Try staying on REDWOOD-EMP only, then reboot and re-try.
IT Support: Also run this in terminal if you can reach the login screen:
```bash
sudo profiles renew -type enrollment
system_profiler SPHardwareDataType | awk -F: '/Serial/ {print $2}'
```
IT Support: If the first command errors, paste output here.
Alex Morgan: Ran both. profiles command returned "Enrollment operation failed: network error (28)". serial matches above.
device-bot: [device-lookup] Model: MacBookPro15,4; ABM status: assigned; Kandji device record: not found.
IT Support: ABM assigned but Kandji record missing explains failure. Did you complete the initial ABM/Apple Setup Assistant prompt to allow remote management?
Alex Morgan: I remember a grey dialog about "Remote management" but didn't see allow/continue buttons, just a spinner.
Samir: @IT Support I can push a refresh from Kandji console if you want me to add the device manually. Will need serial and user's email.
IT Support: Please do that, Samir. Alex, leave the laptop on the EMP network and don't skip any setup screens — we'll kick it from our side.
Samir: Pushing manual device enrollment now... will ping when done.
Samir: Done. Kandji shows device record created and profile pushed. Rebooting should finish enroll.
Alex Morgan: Rebooted — setup now completed and I can log in. FileVault enabled and Kandji shows compliant. Thanks everyone! :tada:
Devex Karen: Woo! Welcome aboard Alex — ping me in #devex if you need dotfiles or common dev tools. :wave:
